acceptance_criteria: Preserve or restore initiating and active focus across bounded Agent Supervisor rerenders.
Associate steering and dispatch validation messages with their exact controls using aria-invalid, aria-describedby, and aria-errormessage.
Keep keyboard behavior, action reachability, and exact confirmation tokens unchanged.
Do not bypass confirmation, weaken dispatch guards, or change policy, binding, security, or accessibility contracts.
objective: Preserve focus across controlled Agent Supervisor rerenders and associate steering and dispatch form errors without weakening confirmation or action guards.
visual_effect_summary: No visual redesign. Focus is restored after the existing outerHTML rerender, and steering/dispatch validation messages are bound to their exact controls.
